cards.snippet: Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you saints and apostles and prophets, because God has pronounced for you His judgment…

cards.card_text: Why should heaven and the saints rejoice over Babylon?
cards.verse_text: Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you saints and apostles and prophets, because God has pronounced for you His judgment against her.
cards.snippet: Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you saints and apostles and prophets, because God has pronounced for you His judgment…

cards.card_text: The blood of prophets and saints A treasure of hidden gold A scroll of her secret plans
cards.verse_text: And there was found in her the blood of prophets and saints, and of all who had been slain on the earth.
cards.snippet: And there was found in her the blood of prophets and saints, and of all who had been slain on the earth.

cards.card_text: The righteous acts of the saints The riches of the great city The prayers of the twenty-four elders
cards.verse_text: She was given clothing of fine linen, bright and pure.” For the fine linen she wears is the righteous acts of the saints.
cards.snippet: …For the fine linen she wears is the righteous acts of the saints.

cards.card_text: That army marches across the broad expanse of the earth and surrounds the camp of the saints and the beloved city.
cards.verse_text: And they marched across the broad expanse of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city.
cards.snippet: …the broad expanse of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city.

cards.card_text: Satan's army surrounds the camp of the saints and the beloved city.
cards.verse_text: And they marched across the broad expanse of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city.
cards.snippet: …the broad expanse of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city.

cards.card_text: That's how the whole Bible ends, friend: grace for all the saints, and then "Amen." I can't think of a better way to close the book.
cards.verse_text: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all the saints.
cards.snippet: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all the saints.
